intro_en: I develop computational methods for assessing microsatellite instability from DNA sequencing and gene expression data. My work connects DNA-based analysis with bulk and single-cell transcriptomic approaches to study MSI in cancer.
intro_zh: 我致力于开发基于 DNA 测序和基因表达数据的微卫星不稳定性检测方法，研究涵盖 DNA 层面的分析，以及群体和单细胞转录组层面的 MSI 评估。

projects.title_zh: MSIsensor-pro · 基于 DNA 的 MSI 检测
projects.description_en: MSIsensor-pro detects MSI from whole-genome, whole-exome, and targeted sequencing data without requiring a matched normal sample. The method models microsatellite variation and selects informative sites for tumor-only analysis.
projects.description_zh: MSIsensor-pro 支持全基因组、全外显子组和靶向测序数据，无需配对正常样本即可进行 MSI 检测。该方法通过对微卫星变异进行建模并筛选有效位点，实现仅使用肿瘤样本的分析。

projects.title_zh: MSIsensor-RNA · 基于基因表达的 MSI 检测
projects.description_en: MSIsensor-RNA estimates MSI using the expression of MSI-associated genes. It supports bulk and single-cell gene expression data, extending MSI analysis to transcriptomic datasets.
projects.description_zh: MSIsensor-RNA 利用 MSI 相关基因的表达信息评估微卫星不稳定性，支持群体和单细胞基因表达数据，将 MSI 分析扩展到转录组数据。

figure.alt_en: MSIsensor-RNA workflow: microarray, RNA-seq, and single-cell RNA-seq data feed into preprocessing, gene selection, SVM training and testing to predict MSI status.
figure.alt_zh: MSIsensor-RNA 流程：芯片、RNA-seq 和单细胞 RNA-seq 数据经过预处理、基因筛选、SVM 训练与测试，预测 MSI 状态。
figure.credit_en: Jia et al. (2024), Figure 1; © The Author(s).
figure.credit_zh: Jia 等（2024），原文图 1；© 原文作者。

title_zh: 基因组与变异检测基准评估
intro_en: My benchmarking research focuses on reference genomes, variant benchmark datasets, and the evaluation of variant calling methods. I am particularly interested in haplotype-resolved assemblies and genomic regions where reliable variant detection remains difficult.
intro_zh: 我的基准评估研究围绕参考基因组、变异基准数据集和变异检测方法的性能评估展开，重点关注单倍型分辨的基因组组装，以及难以可靠检测变异的复杂基因组区域。

projects.title_en: Chinese Quartet · Assemblies and reference resources
projects.title_zh: Chinese Quartet · 基因组组装与参考资源
projects.description_en: The Chinese Quartet work combines haplotype-resolved genome assemblies with variant benchmarks and family-based reference resources. Related work includes a telomere-to-telomere diploid reference genome, providing complementary resources for genome analysis and method evaluation.
projects.description_zh: Chinese Quartet 相关研究结合单倍型分辨的基因组组装、变异基准数据集和家系参考资源，并进一步构建端粒到端粒的二倍体参考基因组，为基因组分析和方法评估提供互补资源。

figure.alt_en: Chinese Quartet Figure 5: assembly, HiFi and Illumina variant calls are filtered and merged into tiered germline benchmarks, de novo and somatic calls, with distributions of variant characteristics.
figure.alt_zh: Chinese Quartet 原文图 5：对组装、HiFi 和 Illumina 变异检测结果进行筛选与整合，建立分层的生殖系变异基准集，并展示新生变异、体细胞变异及变异特征分布。
figure.credit_en: Jia et al. (2023), Figure 5; © The Author(s).
figure.credit_zh: Jia 等（2023），原文图 5；© 原文作者。

projects.title_zh: 复杂基因组区域 · 变异检测评估
projects.description_en: This work examines SNV calling in the flanks of structural variants and compares structural variant detection from long reads and long-read assemblies. The aim is to understand how genomic context and analysis strategy affect variant calling performance.
projects.description_zh: 这一方向关注结构变异侧翼区域的单核苷酸变异（SNV）检测，以及基于长读长与长读长组装的结构变异检测方法比较，旨在理解基因组背景和分析策略对变异检测性能的影响。
